'''Tenbrai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the Republic. A dark-skinned Human, Tenbrai wore [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] that were brown and tan in [[Color/Legends|color]], and she wielded two [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tenbrai first appeared in Game Update 1.2 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], as the Legacy vendor for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class.<ref name="TOR" />
